escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(escape_asterisks: true, escape_underscores: false))
puts result.content.inspect
```
